name: add-tracing
title_zh: 给 Metabase 的 Clojure 代码按规范
tagline_zh: 后端要加 trace 覆盖时，不用再翻内部约定、猜 span 命名。照着仓库惯例生成代码，改完就能合进 PR。
tagline_en: Stop guessing span names and tracing conventions when instrumenting Metabase backend code. Generate idiomatic.
desc_en: Add OpenTelemetry tracing spans to Clojure code following Metabase tracing conventions. Use when instrumenting backend code with trace coverage.
why_zh: 它读的是仓库自身的 tracing 惯例，不是通用模板。生成的 span 结构、属性命名和现有代码一致。
why_en: It learns from the repo's own tracing conventions, not generic patterns—so generated spans match existing structure and naming.
limit_zh: 只认 Metabase 仓库里的 Clojure 后端代码；前端、非 Clojure 服务、或没装 OpenTelem。
limit_en: Only for Clojure backend code inside Metabase repo; won't touch frontend, other services, or modules without OpenTelemetry deps. Outputs snippets.
